title.narrative: ADVANCING AFRICAS PROMISE OF PEACE AND PROSPERITYPROGRAMME - 01 JUNE 2023

description.narrative: Since 2017, the ISS and Ireland’s DFA have strengthened their engagement on issues of human security in Africa. This informs the framing of annual themes, intended outcomes, planned outputs and key deliverables. This proposal draws on the regional strategy of the Embassy of Ireland, Pretoria, including its renewed efforts to engage substantively at the regional level, given its multi-country accreditation.This proposal details proposed activities and outputs under the drawdown component of the agreement for the period 1 June 2023 – 31 May 2024. This tailored and ongoing dedicated support comprises three main areas of engagement: 1. Providing ongoing, tailored research support and specialised expertise; 2. Increasing Irish and African linkages, networks and cooperation; and3. Provision of in-depth and commissioned country/topic-specific analysis and policy recommendations.
